name: type7_C_funicular_2D_L2000um_eps0.86um
comment: Same 2 mm pore as layout A. Ice by one rule only, the equal-curvature fill (build_ice_layout 'fill'): one ice-gas face radius r for the whole pore at the wall-BC angle 60 deg (D1), so ice spans every stretch whose gap is below 2 r cos(60) = r (narrow gaps, throats, opposing grain tips), with faces of radius r; r is set by bisection for the target ice fraction (the fraction jumps with r, so the result can differ from the target; the builder prints it). No ice faces within 200 um of the collector at x = 0. Target 28 %: funicular (ice along the narrow stretches).
